name: Max Healthcare Institute Ltd.
about: Max Healthcare Institute Limited provides medical and healthcare services in India. It offers services in various specialties, including cardiac sciences, orthopedics, oncology, renal sciences, neurosciences, minimal access and general surgery, pulmonology, obstetrics, bone marrow transplant, bariatric/weight loss surgery, gynecology, minimal access/laparoscopic surgery, eye care/ophthalmology, robotic surgery, paediatrics, nephrology, liver and biliary sciences, gastroenterology and GI surgery, internal medicine, organ transplants, and plastic and reconstructive surgery. The company also provides Max@Home, a platform that offers health and wellness services at home; and Max Lab, which provides diagnostic testing services to patients. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~35% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~22% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE 76 is 47% above the sector median, but its ROCE and growth largely justify that premium.
Since 2023, most of the 23% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 47 → 76), not earnings growth (7% a year).
